title: DELF A2
content_provenance: Domain names and skills are taken from the public DELF A2 syllabus published by France Education International. Weightings describe the four evaluated skills of the diploma; the multiple-choice practice bank covers only the listening, reading and language-structure areas that can be assessed objectively.
content_provenance_note: Original practice items authored from the public syllabus. Not a capture of past exam questions.
